skills.name: Thorough Cleaning!
skills.description: Drops straight down at enemies and attacks them with the Ripper.  *Cancels HP regen  *Cancels enemy buffs   *ATK x 3000% Area Damage

skills.name: Pizza Party
skills.description: Eats pizza, giving good effects on allies.  *Skill Use Rate +60%  (7 sec) *HP +400% (7 sec) *HP x 60% Area Recovery (per sec) (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: GACHIAKUTA
abilities.description: GACHIAKUTA Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy Knockback: Agility
abilities.description: Has a high chance of knocking back all Agility type enemies and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
